scope: Final Carson launcher source, delivery provenance, prepared sweep01 immutable inputs; independent read-only review only

findings.title: Imported tool executes before expected reviewed digest is checked
findings.observation: load_tool hashes payload but its first call has no expected-digest argument or comparison. exec(payload,module.__dict__) occurs before LOADED_TOOL_SHA is populated. installed_command first-loads four ecology modules while snapshot is generated, before reviewed(root,observed); the final source binding check is after execution. execute also first-loads pair_watchdog before comparing its loaded SHA to again.tool_sources_sha256. Changed top-level bytes can therefore execute before refusal; repeat-load consistency does not fix first-load authorization.
findings.evidence_boundary: Current frozen dependency top levels were read; no changed-source payload was executed, no exploit/run was attempted. This is a static fail-closed ordering defect, not evidence that current files already launched an unexpected process.
findings.minimal_required_change: Require expected reviewed SHA in load_tool, compare SHA of payload before exec and execute exactly those bytes. Pair controller can use already verified again.tool_sources_sha256. Metadata dependencies need independently anchored reviewed/frozen expected hashes available before first import, rather than current-source self-hashing and retrospective comparison; cover plan/check as well. Main coordinator owns changes and validation.

checked_controls.provenance: Stored canonical snapshot digest matches delivery. 14 final bindings,40 tool sources,15 frozen inputs,92 runtime files match; source/copied world79 each, production folder inventories, private host/peer116 each, JDKlib66/libraries601/natives6 match. 1251 unique files independently hashed. No readiness exists.
checked_controls.ready_schema: Exact status READY_FOR_ONE_BOUNDED_SWEEP_RUN, run, one_attempt_only true and canonical snapshot digest required; nonblank reviewer plus canonical dedicated-docs relative report path and exact report SHA. Schema validates integrity/reference, not substantive approval of report contents. This review does not approve a run.
checked_controls.default_off: Default mode check; no ready writer. Missing readiness rejected before snapshot imports/platform checks/marker. Prepared and delivery results are not runtime acceptance.
checked_controls.argv_environment: Regenerated argv exactly matches prepared role argv and installed metadata; strict JVM/property/game option validation, role UUID/name/paths fixed, sweep flags and all three ecology action flags false, background true/earlywindow false. Argfiles/agents/unsupported VM options and duplicate flags rejected. JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS,_JAVA_OPTIONS,JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS,CLASSPATH rejected even if empty.
checked_controls.owned_process_entry: Only run enters owned pair controller after checks and exclusive fsynced execution-started marker. Controller creates its own two Popen process groups without shell or attaching existing PID. Startup240/absolute900/save60/TERM15 budgets. Direct-child leader-exit descendant caveat remains; no evidence of actual orphan Java here.
checked_controls.display_user_instances: CoreGraphics reads active/asleep state only; no wake/unlock/focus. Whole-machine ps rejects game/QA/unknown Java with narrow Gradle exception. Reviewer did not invoke platform probes or ps. No existing user process touched.
checked_controls.quiet_helper: Flags false prevent ecology action registration; does not imply no mixin/core callback code loads.
checked_controls.acceptance: Neither COMPLETE marker, process exit, nor connection alone proves gameplay correctness or saved evidence.

limitations: Read-only source/hash review; no launcher import/invocation, Python boundary test rerun, prep, compilation, JVM/game/server/GameTest or GUI operation.
Checks cover frozen sources and current observed file hashes only; subsequent edits need new review/bindings.
Runtime inventory binds assets index, not every assets object.
No ready file written; no automatic launch scheduled. No production, asset, TODO or world changes.
